anti_slop_rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for main headings.
Never exceed text-6xl (3.75rem / 60px) for headlines to ensure strict visual balance.
Pair bold headings with JetBrains Mono overlines in uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Ensure heading and subtitle size jumps do not exceed 2 Tailwind scale steps.

rules: Strict monochrome palette (#000000 / #0A0A0C base with pure white #FFFFFF for high key contrast).
Tint neutrals with 2% cool slate blue (#121216) to avoid flat digital dead grey.
No color gradients or bright rainbow colors — depth is built via stroke borders, noise texture, and layered glass cards.
Buttons and active states use pure white filled backgrounds with black high-contrast text or 1px glowing white borders.

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_strategy: Tetris Mode A: Asymmetrical col-span mixes (col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2, col-span-4, etc.) with wide gap-6 to gap-8 gaps.
spacing_and_layout.section_rhythm: py-20 lg:py-32 between major sections to let content breathe effortlessly.

surface_and_textures.card_style: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800/80 hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8
surface_and_textures.tracing_beam_border: Subtle animated border shimmer or high-key glowing stroke on feature highlights and primary CTAs.
surface_and_textures.noise_overlay: Optional SVG subtle noise or radial grain texture behind hero to kill flat dark pixels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes attached for testing.
Use Lenis smooth scrolling for high-end momentum scroll feel.
Utilize framer-motion for kinetic hero line reveals and scroll entrance animations.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for contact form submission feedback.
Ensure 100% responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile with no horizontal overflow.
Maintain strict monochrome high-contrast aesthetic with sharp typography and subtle 1px borders.
